linkedin.headline: Secondary school maths teacher | Eastbrook Academy
linkedin.about: I teach maths and run the chess club. I mentor younger teachers, I am patient and kind, and I tell dad jokes that students pretend to hate. Community and fairness matter to me and I volunteer as a youth coach. I would like a partner who enjoys board games and honest, thoughtful conversation.
